title: The Defender
description: A bodyguard (Dolph Lundgren) battles an unknown attacker who has ambushed a secret meeting between an American official and a terrorist.

title: A Girl Like Grace
description: Seventeen-year-old Grace (Ryan Destiny) has been raised by her single mother (Garcelle Beauvais), Lisa, in a rather dysfunctional environment. As she yearns for acceptance in the world, Grace finds herself bullied at school by Mary (Raven-Symoné). She seeks guidance from her best friend Andrea (Paige Hurd) and Share, Andrea's older sister.

title: Apple Mortgage Cake
description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

title: Undercover Brother
description: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

title: Motives
description: A successful businessman (Shemar Moore) gets caught in a web of deceit after cheating on his wife (Vivica A. Fox).

title: Motives 2: Retribution
description: A man (Brian J. White) cuts through lies and deceit to investigate the murder of his imprisoned brother (Shemar Moore).

title: The Preacher's Wife
description: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife".

title: Love, Brooklyn
description: Three longtime Brooklynites navigate love, friendship and careers amid the rapidly changing landscape of their beloved city.

title: Make It Happen
description: Embarking on a journey to fulfil her dreams as a dancer, a young girl discovers a new style of dance that proves to be the source of both conflict and self-discovery.

title: Honey
description: Honey Daniels (Jessica Alba) dreams of making a name for herself as a hip-hop choreographer. When she's not busy hitting downtown clubs with her friends, she teaches dance classes at a nearby community center in Harlem, N.Y., as a way to keep kids off the streets. Honey thinks she's hit the jackpot when she meets a hotshot director (David Moscow) who casts her in one of his music videos. But, when he starts demanding sexual favors from her, Honey makes a decision that will change her life.

title: Honey 2
description: A troubled but gifted dancer (Katerina Graham) prepares to compete on a talent show.

title: Paper Soldiers
description: A rookie thief receives on-the-job training from a crew of bungling burglars.

title: Pain & Gain
description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story
